[USER] User is interested in refinishing a vintage side table found at a thrift store.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for refinishing a vintage side table:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Clean it thoroughly with a gentle cleaner and soft-bristled brush.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Assess the condition for damage, scratches, dents, or loose joints.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Strip the old finish using a chemical stripper or sanding method.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Sand the entire table, starting with coarse grit sandpaper (80-100) and moving to finer grits (120-220).
